note: Rows include company affiliation relationships. Repeated license numbers are preserved because one licensee may be associated with multiple companies. Workbooks include names, license numbers, company numbers/names, branch identifiers, email, and company address fields. Same-number licenses appearing in both broker rosters are represented by one licensee with both categories recorded in LicenseType; the higher category is used as LicenseLevel. No roster renewal or issue dates are present, so those fields remain empty and campaign renewal dates continue to be policy-derived.
